name: Jacob Lessard
source:
Known for his tech brilliance, Jacob is in his late twenties and living in Toronto, where he has thrown himself headlong into developing the Penta. Jacob is cold, confident, and reserved, and only seems alive while logged into Vitalia, the Penta’s flagship simulation. 

Raised in an affluent but neglectful household, Jacob has always had trouble connecting with others. His natural tendency for aloofness and strange flashes of genius have pushed most people away from him. His groundbreaking work in virtual reality has become his only safe refuge, and the sole focus of his life.
